status: B10, 18 November 2026. Our side's identification codes in 1985: Kremniy-2M's plug-in code filters, the schedule they are changed on and the paper that carries it (simcore/command/own_air.hpp IffSchedule, docs/air_battle/08_OUR_FIGHTERS.md sections 2.7 and 6).
source: soviet_iff (Kremniy-2 and -2M: band III at 668 MHz, 12 plug-in code filters, 1-8 for peace and 9-12 kept for war, filter 4 for alignment, changed on a secret pre-arranged schedule every one to six hours, a distress reply by answering twice, unencrypted)
notes: soviet_iff is tier 4 and the only source read for the filters and the change period; the day's schedule is drawn from the campaign's stream within these bounds (a filter never follows itself). Parol, Soviet service from 1977 (dewiki_p15, a pointer only), is not ours in 1985: a small Pact nation flies Kremniy-2M.

document.source: game value: the regiment's signals chief issues the next day's schedule as a paper carried by a means that takes documents (docs/air_battle/08_OUR_FIGHTERS.md section 6; pvo_bu_x_1984 art. 17 has the commander check the timely change of identification codes); the hour of issue is a game value
